quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on defensive pressure and court positioning
quotes.excerpt: I always try and pick what point of the court I don't want them to get to.
quotes.quote: First what I do is I always try and pick what point of the court I don't want them to get to. And then from there I balance out how much I'm pressuring. If I don't want them to get all the way to the three-point line, then I'm going to pick a point that I know I need to cut them off at, and then I apply more pressure.
